scope: Retrospective 12:32 row split. Both target CRCs must fail; a distinct, unique CRC-valid wire supplies each row correspondence. The peer's target must pass CRC and header. Only mode and p1,p2,p4,p5,...,p31 are scored. The two branches share their original IQ.
primary: Emit equal octets in a run of at least eight equal directly readable EVS octets, in ascending wire address within one packet, skipping other bytes. Modes and payload use the same rule. No reference bytes participate in constructing runs.
